title: local-backlog story model
description: Single source of truth for the whole local-backlog data model: a story file's fields (types, required-when), the shape of its status-update log, AND the canonical enums those fields draw from — Status values (with their colors), the color palette, Resolution values, and Zone values. Consumed by create-story (generate), update-status/set-zone/idle_server (validate), open-backlog (serve to the viewer), and backlog-viewer (derive its Zod). Nothing about these types may be hand-duplicated outside this file.

status.description: One of the canonical Status values (see x-story-file.enums.status).

resolution.description: Empty unless the story is Done. Invariant: Status = Done ⇔ Resolution set.

note.description: Optional free-text note for the current status — the SAME concept for any transition (into Done or otherwise). Empty when none.

zone.description: Which of Backlog/Planner/Archive the story sits in (see x-story-file.enums.zone). Always present; defaults to Backlog.

history.description: The status transitions in the story's log — lines of the form historySection.line. The section's other lines (historySection.nonTransitionLines) are not entries.

historyEntry.title: history entry
historyEntry.description: One appended status transition in the story's log. Append-only: past entries are never edited or removed. A line that is not a transition (see historySection.nonTransitionLines) is not a historyEntry.

resolution.description: Present when this entry is a transition into Done.

note.description: Optional free-text note for this transition (any status).

x-story-file.description: How the model maps onto the story's Markdown file, and the canonical enums the fields draw from.

historySection.heading: ## History

nonTransitionLines.name: history-section-added
nonTransitionLines.line: - <at> — History section added by /local-backlog:fix (story predates it)

historySection.description: The section is not only transitions: the lines in nonTransitionLines carry the same UTC timestamp but no ` — Status: <from> → <to>`. A reader looking for transitions takes only the lines that have ` — Status: ` right after the timestamp and SKIPS the rest — it must not reject or error on them. Reading a transition entry: the segments are ORDERED and Note is terminal, but a note is free text and may itself contain ` · ` (only newline, CR and `|` are refused, because the note also lands in a table cell). So take everything after the FIRST ` · Note: ` as the note, and look for ` · Resolution: ` only in the part BEFORE it — never split on the last occurrence, and never search for a marker across the whole line. A ` · Resolution: ` that appears inside a note's own text is part of that note, not a segment.

status.description: The canonical Status values and their color. No per-project status list — this is the single source.

statusColor.description: The color-name palette a Status may reference (Tailwind classes per theme-aware badge/border).

resolution.description: The closed set of Resolution values, shared by local-backlog and backlog-viewer.

zone.description: The closed set of Zone values — which of Backlog/Planner/Archive a story sits in. No colors: the viewer shows zones as tabs/columns, not colored badges, unlike status.
